title: December FOMC trade memo
headline: Bets against a 90% consensus that the Fed hikes in December.

steps.thesis: The market prices about a 10% chance the Fed holds on 9 December. I put it nearer 30%.
steps.method: A 95.875 / 96.00 bull call spread on December SOFR futures options, sized so the most I can lose is $750.
steps.tech: Scenario pricing and expected value, built from market-implied odds and live futures prices.
steps.result: Paper trade open. The post-mortem goes up after the 9 December decision.

title: Pricing coffee derivatives
headline: Prices one coffee option three ways, then designs a structured note around it.
context: Citi Markets Quant job simulation (Forage) · July 2026

steps.thesis: A six-month coffee call needs a fair price, and the desk needs to know its risk after selling it.
steps.method: Cost of carry, then Black-76, then a 500,000-path Monte Carlo; a coffee-linked note; a desk risk review.
steps.result: Black-76 and Monte Carlo agree to within 0.02%. The note is solved at 40.9% participation.

title: Liquidity-sweep backtest
headline: Tests whether false breakouts of recent highs and lows reverse often enough to trade.

steps.thesis: Do false breakouts of recent highs and lows reverse often enough to trade?
steps.method: A 96-combination grid search, tuned on two years of data and then tested blind on a third.
steps.tech: Python and pandas, ATR-based position sizing, and a Sharpe decay test for overfitting.
steps.result: Weak on daily data. The write-up explains why and sets out a better test.
